crop.notes: Whole item, headline 'IN GRAPHIC STYLE. John Ryan Describes His Punishment at the Hands of Tom Allen.' through 'Judge Cady fined Ryan $15.'

ocr.notes: Accurate apart from a few dialect spellings in Ryan's quote ('de jaw' as 'de juw', 'h'I' as 'h'l', ''im' as ''lm', 'habout' as 'hbabout').

title.suggested: John Ryan describes his punishment at the hands of Tom Allen

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that John Ryan, beaten by Tom Allen for refusing to keep away from his saloon, threw stones through the saloon windows and was fined $15 for malicious trespass.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Friday, July 20, 1888', page 3.

facts.fact: Allen ordered his former friend John Ryan, a young Englishman, to keep away from his saloon and gave him a terrible beating when he would not; Ryan then threw stones through the saloon's windows
On Allen's charge of malicious trespass, Judge Cady fined John Ryan $15

notes: Only the title's capitalization is wrong ('tom allen').
